/* Reset & Root Variables */
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

:root {
  --font-sans: 'Outfit', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', "Courier New", Courier, monospace;

  /* Color Palette (coNinja Warm Orangish-Black & Samurai Orange Theme) */
  --bg-base: #060403; /* Deep warm black with amber undertone */
  --bg-surface: rgba(16, 11, 9, 0.65);
  --bg-surface-hover: rgba(28, 19, 15, 0.75);
  --bg-panel: rgba(12, 8, 7, 0.75);
  
  --border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08); /* Stylized orange copper border */
  --border-hover: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35);
  
  --text-primary: #f8fafc;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
  --text-muted: #5e5248;
  
  /* Accent Colors mapped to preserve JS class integration */
  --accent-purple: #ff7300; /* Vibrant Samurai Orange */
  --accent-purple-glow: rgba(255, 90, 0, 0.28);
  --accent-cyan: #FFB300; /* Amber Gold */
  --accent-cyan-glow: rgba(255, 160, 0, 0.18);
  --accent-green: #FFB300; /* Map test coverage to Amber Gold */
  --accent-green-glow: rgba(255, 160, 0, 0.18);
  --accent-warning: #f59e0b;
  --accent-warning-glow: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25);
  --accent-error: #ef4444;
  --accent-error-glow: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
  
  /* Shadow & Blur */
  --glass-blur: blur(24px) saturate(190%);
  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);

  /* SMOOTHER Premium Transition Curves (easeOutExpo & Spring) */
  --transition-smooth: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --transition-spring: all 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  /* Rich radial gradient for a premium orangish-black background */
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #150d0a 0%, #050302 100%);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* Ambient Background Blobs (Stealth Charcoal Shadows & Orange Fire flares) */
.ambient-glow {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(150px);
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.35;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.glow-1 {
  width: 600px;
  height: 600px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-purple-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: -15%;
  left: 5%;
  animation: float-glow-1 25s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
}

.glow-2 {
  width: 650px;
  height: 650px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-cyan-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
  bottom: -20%;
  right: 5%;
  animation: float-glow-2 30s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
}

.glow-3 {
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: 40%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

@keyframes float-glow-1 {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  100% { transform: translate(60px, 40px) scale(1.15); }
}

@keyframes float-glow-2 {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1.1); }
  100% { transform: translate(-80px, -50px) scale(0.9); }
}

/* Layout Shell */
.dashboard-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100vh;
}

/* Topbar Navigation */
.topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 70px;
  padding: 0 24px;
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  z-index: 10;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

/* Spinning Shuriken Logo */
.shuriken-logo {
  position: relative;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: transparent !important;
  animation: spin-shuriken-active 7s infinite linear;

}

.shuriken-svg {
  width: 100%;

  transition: var(--transition-spring);
}

.shuriken-logo:hover .shuriken-svg {
  transform: scale(1.15);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.95));
}

@keyframes spin-shuriken-active {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* Custom Japanese SVG Icon styling */

/* Base Buttons */
.btn {

.tab-content {

}

/* Graph View styling */
.graph-container {
  flex: 1;
  background-color: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 12px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  min-height: 400px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}

#swarm-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.graph-legend {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 16px;
  left: 16px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.75);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.legend-item .dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
}

.legend-item .dot.active { background-color: var(--accent-purple); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-purple); }
.legend-item .dot.thinking { background-color: var(--accent-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-cyan); }
.legend-item .dot.idle { background-color: var(--text-muted); }
.legend-item .dot.error { background-color: var(--accent-error); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-error); }

/* Kanban Board View */
.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.filter-pills {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  padding: 4px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 30px;
}

.pill {
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.pill:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.pill.active {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  color: #ff9d4d;
}

.kanban-board {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.kanban-col {
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.45);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.col-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.col-header h3 {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.card-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
  position: relative;
}

/* Kanban Cards */
.task-card {
  background-color: rgba(20, 15, 12, 0.55);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px;
  cursor: grab;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.task-card:hover {
  background-color: rgba(36, 26, 20, 0.75);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 15px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08);
}

/* Katana Slash Swipe Animation on Active Cards */
.task-card.active-border-glow {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  position: relative;
}

.task-card.active-border-glow::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  left: -60%;
  width: 25%;
  height: 200%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 30%,
    rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.45) 50%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 70%,
    transparent
  );
  transform: rotate(30deg);
  animation: katana-slash-animation 3.2s infinite linear;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes katana-slash-animation {
  0% { left: -60%; }
  100% { left: 140%; }
}

.task-card .card-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.task-card .task-title {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.task-card .card-desc {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.task-card .card-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  padding-top: 8px;
}

.task-card .card-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
}

.task-card .tag {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.task-card .card-assignee {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.task-card .avatar-icon {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.55rem;
}

.task-card .priority-icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.task-card .priority-icon.p5 { color: var(--accent-error); }
.task-card .priority-icon.p4 { color: var(--accent-warning); }
.task-card .priority-icon.p3 { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

/* Progress bar inside In Progress card */
.card-progress-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.card-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #cc5200 0%, #ff7300 50%, #cc5200 100%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer-progress 2s infinite linear;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

@keyframes shimmer-progress {
  0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

/* Glass Card */
.glass-card {
  background-color: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 12px;
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  padding: 20px;
}

/* Decisions View */
.decision-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.decision-card {
  background-color: rgba(18, 14, 12, 0.45);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 18px;
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.decision-card.pending {
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.05);
}

.decision-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;
}

.decision-title-group h3 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.decision-meta {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.decision-confidence {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.confidence-val {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.confidence-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.decision-desc {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.decision-options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.option-box {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.option-box.selected {
  border-color: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.35);
  background-color: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.02);
}

.option-box h4 {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.option-box .pros-cons {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: 6px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.decision-rationale {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.02);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-purple);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.decision-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

/* System Console Logs styling */
.console-viewport {
  background-color: #040302;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  min-height: 350px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
}

.console-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
}

.console-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.console-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.console-line {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.console-line .timestamp {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.console-line .agent {
  font-weight: 600;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.console-line .agent.orchestrator { color: #f472b6; }
.console-line .agent.architect { color: #c084fc; }
.console-line .agent.coder { color: #60a5fa; }
.console-line .agent.tester { color: #34d399; }
.console-line .agent.security { color: #f87171; }
.console-line .agent.system { color: #38bdf8; }

.console-line .message {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.console-line.error .message {
  color: #f87171;
}

.console-line.success .message {
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

/* Settings Forms styling */
.settings-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.settings-grid .full-width {
  grid-column: span 2;
}

.settings-card .card-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.settings-card .card-title h3 {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.settings-card .card-title .jp-icon {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

.settings-card .card-title i.icon-warning { color: var(--accent-warning); }
.settings-card .card-title i.icon-success { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
.settings-card .card-title i.icon-info { color: var(--accent-purple); }

.settings-card .card-desc {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.radio-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.radio-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.005);
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.radio-option:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border-color: var(--border-hover);
}

.radio-option input[type="radio"] {
  margin-top: 4px;
  accent-color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.radio-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.option-name {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.option-desc {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.setting-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 14px 0;
}

.setting-row.border-top {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.setting-label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.setting-label .name {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.setting-label .desc {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.setting-input-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.slider {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 150px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  outline: none;
  accent-color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.slider-value {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  min-width: 50px;
  text-align: right;
}

/* Inputs and Selects */
.form-input {
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  width: 100%;
  outline: none;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.form-input:focus {
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
}

.form-select {
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.8);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.form-select option {
  background-color: var(--bg-base);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* Provider Table Settings */
.provider-table-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.provider-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  text-align: left;
}

.provider-table th {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.provider-table td {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}

.provider-name {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.provider-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.provider-dot.online { background-color: var(--accent-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-cyan); }
.provider-dot.offline { background-color: var(--text-muted); }

.text-xs { font-size: 0.75rem; }
.text-muted { color: var(--text-muted); }

/* Right Sidebar Context Panel */
.context-panel {
  width: 320px;
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.6);
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.pane-view {
  display: none;
  padding: 24px 20px;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.pane-view.active {
  display: flex;
}

.pane-header-agent, .pane-header-task {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.avatar-ring {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  padding: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-purple) 0%, var(--accent-cyan) 100%);
  position: relative;
}

.avatar-ring.active-pulse::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -2px; left: -2px; right: -2px; bottom: -2px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent-purple);
  animation: pulse-ring 2.5s infinite;
}

.avatar-inner {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #1e1916;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.name-status h3 {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.status-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.status-badge.status-thinking { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
.status-badge.status-coding { color: var(--accent-purple); }
.status-badge.status-idle { color: var(--text-muted); }

.border-top {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-top: 16px;
}

.section-title {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.section-text {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.active-task-brief {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px;
}

.active-task-brief .task-icon {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.1);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.active-task-brief .task-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.active-task-brief .task-title {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.active-task-brief .task-meta {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.skills-flex {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.skill-tag {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.hardware-metrics {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.hw-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.hw-item .hw-name {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.hw-item .hw-val {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.hw-item .hw-val.success { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

/* Task details specifics */
.task-id {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.simple-param-table {
  width: 100%;
}

.simple-param-table td {
  padding: 6px 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.simple-param-table td:first-child {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  width: 40%;
}

.simple-param-table td:last-child {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.text-highlight {
  color: var(--accent-purple) !important;
}

.dependencies-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
}

.task-terminal-output {
  background-color: #040302;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  height: 120px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  line-height: 1.4;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

/* Modals & Wizards styling */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background-color: rgba(5, 4, 3, 0);
  backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
  z-index: 100;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), backdrop-filter 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.modal-overlay.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  background-color: rgba(5, 4, 3, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.modal-card {
  width: 550px;
  background-color: #0c0a08;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 45px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  overflow: hidden;
  transform: scale(0.93) translateY(20px);
  transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.modal-overlay.active .modal-card {
  transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
}

.modal-header {
  padding: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  position: relative;
}

.wizard-header-logo {
  font-size: 1.75rem;
}

.wizard-header-text h3 {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.wizard-header-text p {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px; right: 20px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1;
}

.modal-close:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.modal-body {
  padding: 24px;
}

.wizard-step {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.wizard-step.active {
  display: flex;
}

.form-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.form-group label {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.wizard-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

/* PM Chat Bubble */
.wizard-chat-bubble {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.bubble-sender {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #ff9133;
}

.wizard-chat-bubble p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.wizard-chat-bubble ol {
  padding-left: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

/* Loader steps */
.decomposition-loader {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 0;
}

.spinner-ring {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border: 3px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.1);
  border-top-color: var(--accent-purple);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spinner 1s linear infinite;
}

.progress-bar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-purple) 0%, var(--accent-cyan) 100%);
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: width 0.4s ease;
}

.decomposition-steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  padding-top: 16px;
}

.decomp-step {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.decomp-step.pending {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.decomp-step.active-step {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.decomp-step.completed {
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.hide {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes fade-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes spinner {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes pulse-dot {
  0% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.6; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes pulse-ring {
  0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.7); opacity: 0.7; }
  100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.4); opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes pulse-loader {
  0% { transform: translate(-30%) scaleX(1); opacity: 0.6; }
  50% { transform: translate(30%) scaleX(1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translate(-30%) scaleX(1); opacity: 0.6; }
}

/* Smoke Puff Cloud Animation Elements ( বিলীয়মান কুয়াশা ) */
.smoke-puff-container {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 100;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.smoke-particle {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 140, 50, 0.22) 0%, rgba(60, 50, 45, 0.45) 50%, rgba(20, 15, 12, 0.15) 75%, transparent 100%);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.1);
  /* Smoother, billowing smoke puff expansion using easeOutExpo cubic-bezier */
  animation: smoke-puff-animation 0.95s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

@keyframes smoke-puff-animation {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.1) rotate(0deg);
  }
  30% {
    opacity: 0.95;
    filter: blur(1px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(2.4) rotate(45deg);
    filter: blur(6px);
  }
}

/* Custom Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.2);
}

/* Responsiveness */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .sidebar { width: 70px; padding: 20px 8px; }
  .sidebar span, .sidebar-footer { display: none; }
  .nav-item .jp-icon { margin-right: 0; }
  .kanban-board { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .context-panel { width: 280px; }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .main-shell { flex-direction: column; }
  .sidebar { width: 100%; height: auto; flex-direction: row; border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 10px; }
  .nav-menu { flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-around; width: 100%; }
  .context-panel { width: 100%; border-left: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); height: 300px; }
  .kanban-board { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .settings-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .settings-grid .full-width { grid-column: auto; }
}

/* Dojo Workbench Styling */
.viewport:has(#tab-dojo-workbench.active) {
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

#tab-dojo-workbench.tab-content {
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Sidebar Resizer Handle & Collapse Toggle */
.sidebar-resizer {
  width: 4px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.05);
  cursor: col-resize;
  position: relative;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
  z-index: 5;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sidebar-resizer:hover, .sidebar-resizer.dragging {
  background-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-purple-glow);
}

.resizer-collapse-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 14px;
  height: 38px;
  background-color: #1e1410;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.resizer-collapse-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: white;
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-purple-glow);
}

/* Collapsed state adjustments */
.workbench-sidebar.collapsed {
  width: 0 !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border-right: none !important;
}

.workbench-sidebar.collapsed .workbench-tabs,
.workbench-sidebar.collapsed .workbench-tab-content {
  display: none !important;
}

.workbench-sidebar.collapsed + .sidebar-resizer .resizer-collapse-btn {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(180deg);
}

.workbench-layout {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #060403;
}

/* Left Sidebar (Scrolls / Blueprint / Checklist) */
.workbench-sidebar {
  width: 280px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: rgba(10, 7, 6, 0.6);
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.workbench-tabs {
  display: flex;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background-color: rgba(6, 4, 3, 0.5);
}

.w-tab {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.w-tab:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
}

.w-tab.active {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-purple);
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04);
}

.workbench-tab-content {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 16px;
}

.w-pane-view {
  display: none;
}

.w-pane-view.active {
  display: block;
}

/* Scrolls Tree Explorer */
.explorer-header, .checklist-header {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.file-tree {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.file-tree-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.file-tree-item:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.06);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transform: translateX(2px);
}

.file-tree-item.active {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  color: #ff9d4d;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.2);
}

/* Blueprint Markdown Viewer */
.blueprint-viewer {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.blueprint-viewer h1, .blueprint-viewer h2, .blueprint-viewer h3 {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin: 16px 0 8px 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.1);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}

.blueprint-viewer h1:first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.blueprint-viewer ul, .blueprint-viewer ol {
  padding-left: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.blueprint-viewer li {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.blueprint-viewer strong {
  color: #ff9d4d;
}

/* Checklist Items */
.checklist-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.checklist-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px;
  background-color: rgba(20, 15, 12, 0.35);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.checklist-item:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.2);
}

/* Ninja Checkbox Style */
.ninja-checkbox {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--text-muted);
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  color: transparent;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
}

.checklist-item:hover .ninja-checkbox {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.checklist-item.checked .ninja-checkbox {
  background-color: var(--accent-purple);
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-purple-glow);
}

.checklist-item.in-progress .ninja-checkbox {
  background-color: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.15);
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.checklist-item-text {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.4;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.checklist-item.checked .checklist-item-text {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.checklist-item.in-progress .checklist-item-text {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Right Main Layout Workspace */
.workbench-main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.workbench-workspace {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

/* Toggle Panel Views */
.workbench-workspace.view-editor .browser-panel {
  display: none !important;
}

.workbench-workspace.view-editor .editor-panel {
  display: flex !important;
  border-right: none !important;
}

.workbench-workspace.view-browser .editor-panel {
  display: none !important;
}

.workbench-workspace.view-browser .browser-panel {
  display: flex !important;
}

/* Panel Containers */
.workbench-panel {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: rgba(14, 11, 9, 0.4);
}

.editor-panel {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

/* Tab Header */
.panel-tab-header {
  height: 38px;
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.85);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 16px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  user-select: none;
}

.active-tab-title {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.active-file-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

/* Monaco container */
#monaco-editor-container {
  flex: 1;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #0c0806;
}

/* Browser mock layout */
.browser-panel {
  background-color: #050302;
}

.browser-topbar {
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.95) !important;
  justify-content: flex-start !important;
  gap: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15) !important;
}

.browser-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.dot-btn {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.dot-btn.red { background-color: #ef4444; }
.dot-btn.yellow { background-color: #f59e0b; }
.dot-btn.green { background-color: #10b981; }

.browser-address {
  flex: 1;
  height: 24px;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 12px;
  gap: 8px;
  max-width: 450px;
}

.ssl-lock {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

#browser-url-bar {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  flex: 1;
  outline: none;
}

.browser-reload {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.browser-reload:hover {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.browser-viewport {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  background-color: #0b0705;
  padding: 20px;
  position: relative;
}

/* Terminal console styling */
.terminal-panel {
  height: 180px;
  background-color: #040302;
  flex: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.terminal-header {
  background-color: #060403 !important;
}

.terminal-status {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.terminal-body {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #cbd5e1;
  background-color: #040302;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
  height: calc(100% - 38px);
}

.term-line {
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  word-break: break-all;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.term-line.system { color: #38bdf8; }
.term-line.compiler { color: #f472b6; }
.term-line.test-pass { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
.term-line.test-fail { color: var(--accent-error); }
.term-line.prompt { color: #10b981; }

/* Inbuilt Ninja Previews inside Viewport */
.ninja-browser-preview {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

.preview-navbar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
}

.preview-logo {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ff7300;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.preview-nav-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.preview-nav-link.active {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.preview-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.preview-card {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.preview-card-title {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.preview-card-value {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.preview-card-value.orange {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.preview-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

.preview-list-title {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.preview-list-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  padding: 6px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* Fitness Path Map SVG */
.fitness-map-preview {
  width: 100%;
  height: 120px;
  background-color: #050302;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.1);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.fitness-path-stroke {
  stroke: var(--accent-purple);
  stroke-width: 3;
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 600;
  stroke-dashoffset: 600;
  animation: draw-path 6s infinite linear;
}

@keyframes draw-path {
  to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}

/* --- DOJO NINE-CO-NINJA THEMING OVERRIDES & ENHANCEMENTS --- */

/* 1. Shuriken Clip-Path for Browser Control Dots */
.dot-btn {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  background-color: currentColor;
  clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 58% 35%, 93% 25%, 65% 48%, 93% 75%, 58% 65%, 50% 100%, 42% 65%, 7% 75%, 35% 48%, 7% 25%, 42% 35%);
  transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.3s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.dot-btn.red { color: #ef4444; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6)); }
.dot-btn.yellow { color: #f59e0b; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6)); }
.dot-btn.green { color: #10b981; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6)); }

.dot-btn:hover {
  transform: scale(1.25) rotate(360deg);
  filter: saturate(1.5) brightness(1.2) drop-shadow(0 0 8px currentColor);
}

/* 2. Scroll-Like Styling for Inbuilt Browser Cards */
.preview-card {
  background: linear-gradient(to right, #0e0907 0%, #1c1410 50%, #0e0907 100%) !important;
  border-left: 3px double var(--accent-purple) !important;
  border-right: 3px double var(--accent-purple) !important;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.03) !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  position: relative;
}

.preview-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25), transparent);
}

/* 3. Ninja-Themed Terminal Output Colors */
.term-line.system {
  color: #a38c7a !important; /* Parchment gray-brown */
}

.term-line.compiler {
  color: var(--accent-cyan) !important; /* Amber gold */
  text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.15);
}

.term-line.test-pass {
  color: #ff9d4d !important; /* Light copper orange */
  text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255, 157, 77, 0.15);
}

.term-line.test-fail {
  color: #ef4444 !important; /* Crimson blood red */
  text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.term-line.prompt {
  color: var(--accent-purple) !important; /* Samurai Orange */
  font-weight: 600;
  text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.3);
}

/* Scanlines Effect for Dojo Terminal */
.terminal-body {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 12, 10, 0.98), rgba(6, 4, 3, 0.99)) !important;
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.05);
}

.terminal-body::after {
  content: " ";
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%);
  background-size: 100% 4px;
  z-index: 10;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* 4. Custom Switch Toggles for Settings */
.switch {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 42px;
  height: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.switch input {
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}

.slider-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  transition: .35s var(--transition-smooth);
  border-radius: 34px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.slider-toggle:before {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  height: 12px;
  width: 12px;
  left: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  background-color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: .35s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

input:checked + .slider-toggle {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
}

input:checked + .slider-toggle:before {
  transform: translateX(22px);
  background-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-purple-glow);
}

/* 5. Responsive Workbench Split-Pane Media Queries */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  #tab-dojo-workbench.tab-content {
    height: auto;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  
  .workbench-layout {
    flex-direction: column;
    height: auto;
  }
  
  .workbench-sidebar {
    width: 100%;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    height: 320px;
  }
  
  .workbench-workspace {
    flex-direction: column;
    height: auto;
  }
  
  .editor-panel {
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    height: 400px;
  }
  
  .browser-panel {
    height: 400px;
  }
  
  .terminal-panel {
    height: 220px;
  }
}

@keyframes spin-shuriken {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* --- OPEN CLAW CONTROL SUB-TABS --- */
.settings-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  padding: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.s-tab {
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.s-tab:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.s-tab.active {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25);
  color: #ff9d4d;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.05);
}

.s-pane-view {
  display: none;
  animation: fade-in 0.35s ease-out forwards;
}

.s-pane-view.active {
  display: block;
}

/* GPU VRAM Allocator */
.vram-visualizer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 4px;
}

.vram-bar-label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.vram-bar-container {
  height: 12px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.vram-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #cc5200 0%, #ff7300 70%, #ffb300 100%);
  border-radius: 20px;
  transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.tools-explorer-list {
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 10px;
}

/* --- STEALTH ARCHIVES REPORTS VIEW --- */
.archive-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: calc(100vh - 160px);
}

.archive-sidebar {
  width: 220px;
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.45);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px;
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.archive-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.archive-group .group-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.archive-item {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.005);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.archive-item:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-color: var(--border-color);
}

.archive-item.active {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.1);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25);
  color: #ff9d4d;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.05);
}

.archive-viewport {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.report-card {
  padding: 24px;
  background-color: var(--bg-panel);
}

.report-title-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.report-title-row h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.report-meta {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.report-meta span {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.report-section {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.report-section h4 {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.report-section p {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.report-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.report-table th {
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.report-table td {
  padding: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.report-table tr:hover td {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.lift-badge {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.lift-badge.negative {
  color: var(--accent-error);
}

.report-summary-box {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.015);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 14px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.report-learnings-box {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.005);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-purple);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* A/B REPORT CARDS & SIGNIFICANCE BAR */
/* ============================================================ */

.report-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.report-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.report-meta {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.report-summary {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.3);
  padding-left: 10px;
}

.ab-variants-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.ab-variant-card {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.ab-variant-card.winner-variant {
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.4);
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08);
}

.ab-variant-name {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.ab-stats-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}

.ab-stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  flex: 1;
}

.ab-stat-val {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.ab-stat-val.orange {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.ab-stat-val.lift-positive {
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.ab-stat-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.stats-sig-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.stat-sig-item {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 12px 8px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.stat-sig-item:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}

.sig-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.sig-val {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.sig-val.orange {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.report-recommendation {
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.rec-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.report-recommendation p {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* SETTINGS SUB-TABS */
/* ============================================================ */

.settings-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 0 24px 0 24px;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  overflow-x: auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.settings-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 2px; }

.s-tab {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  position: relative;
  bottom: -1px;
}

.s-tab:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35);
}

.s-tab.active {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.settings-content {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px 24px;
}

.s-pane-view {
  display: none;
}

.s-pane-view.active {
  display: block;
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* ARCHIVE SIDEBAR & VIEWPORT */
/* ============================================================ */

.archive-layout {
  display: flex;
  height: calc(100% - 80px);
  gap: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.archive-sidebar {
  width: 200px;
  min-width: 180px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  padding: 12px 8px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.archive-group {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.group-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  padding: 0 8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.archive-item {
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.archive-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.06);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.archive-item.active {
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  font-weight: 600;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-purple);
  padding-left: 8px;
}

.archive-viewport {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 16px;
}

.report-card {
  min-height: 200px;
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* MCP TOOLS EXPLORER ITEMS */
/* ============================================================ */

.tool-item {
  padding: 4px 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* BADGE SUCCESS VARIANT */
/* ============================================================ */

.badge-success {
  background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15);
  color: #22c55e;
  border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* VRAM BAR */
/* ============================================================ */

.vram-visualizer {
  width: 100%;
}

.vram-bar-label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.vram-bar-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.vram-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff7300, #ffb300);
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* SETTINGS GRID & CARDS */
/* ============================================================ */

.settings-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

.settings-card {
  padding: 16px;
}

.card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.settings-card.full-width {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.card-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.card-title h3 {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.card-desc {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.models-allocation-table-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* PROVIDER TABLE (reused for settings tables) */
/* ============================================================ */

.provider-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.provider-table th {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.provider-table td {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.provider-table tr:hover td {
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.02);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* AGENT PERSONA TUNER (Yin-Yang Balance)                      */
/* ============================================================ */

.persona-tuner-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.persona-labels {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 2px;
}

.persona-pole {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.persona-pole small {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
}

.persona-pole.yin { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.persona-pole.yang { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

.persona-readout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 2px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.persona-readout-label {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.persona-readout-val {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* DOJO SEALS — Unsealed danger highlight                      */
/* ============================================================ */

.radio-option:has(input[value='unsealed']:checked) {
  border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.45);
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05);
}

.radio-option:has(input[value='unsealed']:checked) .option-name {
  color: var(--accent-error);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* TIME-LAPSE VIEWER BAR                                       */
/* ============================================================ */

/* Reserve room at the bottom for the time-lapse bar */
.dashboard-shell {
  height: calc(100vh - 44px);
}

.timelapse-bar {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 44px;
  background: rgba(6, 4, 3, 0.93);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(190%);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  z-index: 200;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.timelapse-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 16px;
  height: 100%;
}

/* ── Controls ── */
.timelapse-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-btn {
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.18);
  border-radius: 5px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  padding: 0;
}

.tl-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08);
}

.tl-btn.tl-play {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.tl-btn.tl-playing {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35);
}

.tl-icon {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
}

.tl-speed {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  padding: 2px 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  margin-left: 4px;
  height: 22px;
}

.tl-speed option { background: var(--bg-base); }

/* ── Track container ── */
.timelapse-track-container {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.timelapse-time-labels {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 2px;
}

.timelapse-time-labels span {
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.timelapse-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 20px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: crosshair;
}

/* ── Histogram blips ── */
.timelapse-blips {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.5px;
  padding: 1px 1px 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.tl-blip {
  flex: 1;
  border-radius: 1px 1px 0 0;
  min-height: 2px;
  opacity: 0.65;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

/* ── Range scrubber overlay ── */
.tl-scrubber {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  outline: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.tl-scrubber::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 2px;
  height: 20px;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-scrubber::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 2px;
  height: 20px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-scrubber::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { background: transparent; }
.tl-scrubber::-moz-range-track { background: transparent; }

/* ── Animated playhead ── */
.tl-playhead {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.9), 0 0 2px rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.6);
  border-radius: 1px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 3;
  transition: left 0.12s linear;
}

/* ── Right status area ── */
.timelapse-status {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-timestamp {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.tl-ts-label {
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.tl-ts-val {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  min-width: 110px;
  text-align: right;
}

.tl-live-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  user-select: none;
}

.tl-live-badge:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25);
}

.tl-live-badge.live-active {
  color: #22c55e;
  border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
  background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.06);
}

.tl-live-dot {
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--text-muted);
  transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-live-badge.live-active .tl-live-dot {
  background: #22c55e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.8);
  animation: live-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes live-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.65); }
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .timelapse-time-labels { display: none; }
  .timelapse-bar { height: 38px; }
  .dashboard-shell { height: calc(100vh - 38px); }
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* MCP REGISTRY PANEL                                          */
/* ============================================================ */

.mcp-hub-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 16px;
  height: calc(100vh - 180px);
}

.mcp-control-panel {
  width: 320px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.mcp-main-panel {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.mcp-nodes-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

.mcp-node-card {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.mcp-node-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08);
}

.mcp-node-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.mcp-node-header h4 {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.mcp-tools-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.mcp-tool-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* NEURAL GRAPH LAYOUT                                         */
/* ============================================================ */

.neural-graph-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: calc(100vh - 160px);
  background: rgba(5, 3, 2, 0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 16px;
}

#neural-graph-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.graph-control-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  left: 12px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 10;
}

.node-detail-drawer {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 320px;
  background: rgba(12, 8, 6, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.18);
  box-shadow: -5px 0 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
  z-index: 20;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.node-detail-drawer.open {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.drawer-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.drawer-header h4 {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin: 0;
}

.drawer-close {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px;
}

.drawer-close:hover {
  color: var(--accent-error);
}

.drawer-body {
  padding: 16px;
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.node-meta-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.node-meta-item .meta-label {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.node-meta-item .meta-val {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.scroll-whisper-container {
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.03);
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.scroll-whisper-container h5 {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-purple);
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.scroll-whisper-container p {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin: 0;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ============================================================ */
/* SANDBOX MULTIPLEXER GRID                                    */
/* ============================================================ */

.multiplexer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 16px;
  height: calc(100vh - 180px);
}

.multiplexer-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100%;
}

.multiplexer-terminal {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  background: #040201 !important;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  position: relative;
}

.multiplexer-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 5px;
}

.multiplexer-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.multiplexer-terminal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--accent-purple);
}

.multiplexer-terminal .log-line {
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

/* Responsive adjustment for 2x2 grid */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .multiplexer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    height: auto;
    overflow-y: visible;
  }
  .multiplexer-panel {
    height: 300px;
  }
}

```

## styles.css
```
/* Reset & Root Variables */
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

*:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #ff7300;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

:root {
  --font-sans: 'Outfit', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', "Courier New", Courier, monospace;

  /* Color Palette (coNinja Warm Orangish-Black & Samurai Orange Theme) */
  --bg-base: #060403; /* Deep warm black with amber undertone */
  --bg-radial-start: #150d0a;
  --bg-radial-end: #050302;
  --bg-surface: rgba(16, 11, 9, 0.65);
  --bg-surface-hover: rgba(28, 19, 15, 0.75);
  --bg-panel: rgba(12, 8, 7, 0.75);
  --bg-panel-dark: #040302;
  --bg-card-dark: rgba(20, 15, 12, 0.55);
  --bg-card-hover: rgba(36, 26, 20, 0.75);
  
  --border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.08); /* Stylized orange copper border */
  --border-hover: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.35);
  --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  
  --text-primary: #f8fafc;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
  --text-muted: #5e5248;
  
  /* Accent Colors mapped to preserve JS class integration */
  --accent-purple: #ff7300; /* Vibrant Samurai Orange */
  --accent-purple-glow: rgba(255, 90, 0, 0.28);
  --accent-orange: #ff7300; /* Samurai Orange - alias for accent-purple */
  --accent-cyan: #FFB300; /* Amber Gold */
  --accent-cyan-glow: rgba(255, 160, 0, 0.18);
  --accent-green: #FFB300; /* Map test coverage to Amber Gold */
  --accent-green-glow: rgba(255, 160, 0, 0.18);
  --accent-warning: #f59e0b;
  --accent-warning-glow: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25);
  --accent-error: #ef4444;
  --accent-error-glow: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
  
  /* Shadow & Blur */
  --glass-blur: blur(24px) saturate(190%);
  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.15);

  /* Layout Spacing Tokens */
  --space-xxs: 2px;
  --space-xs: 4px;
  --space-sm: 8px;
  --space-md: 12px;
  --space-lg: 16px;
  --space-xl: 20px;
  --space-xxl: 24px;
  --space-3xl: 32px;
  
  /* Borders & Radius */
  --radius-xs: 4px;
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 12px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;
  
  --border-width-sm: 1px;
  --border-width-md: 2px;

  /* Scrollbar Tokens */
  --scrollbar-width: 6px;
  --scrollbar-track-bg: transparent;
  --scrollbar-thumb-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  --scrollbar-thumb-hover: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25);

  /* SMOOTHER Premium Transition Curves (easeOutExpo & Spring) */
  --transition-smooth: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --transition-spring: all 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  /* Rich radial gradient for a premium orangish-black background */
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, var(--bg-radial-start) 0%, var(--bg-radial-end) 100%);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* Ambient Background Blobs (Stealth Charcoal Shadows & Orange Fire flares) */
.ambient-glow {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(150px);
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.35;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.glow-1 {
  width: 600px;
  height: 600px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-purple-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: -15%;
  left: 5%;
  animation: float-glow-1 25s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
}

.glow-2 {
  width: 650px;
  height: 650px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-cyan-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
  bottom: -20%;
  right: 5%;
  animation: float-glow-2 30s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
}

.glow-3 {
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.04) 0%, transparent 70%);
  top: 40%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}

@keyframes float-glow-1 {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  100% { transform: translate(60px, 40px) scale(1.15); }
}

@keyframes float-glow-2 {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1.1); }
  100% { transform: translate(-80px, -50px) scale(0.9); }
}

/* Layout Shell */
.dashboard-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100vh;
}

/* Topbar Navigation */
.topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 90px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-xxl) 16px var(--space-xxl);
  background-color: rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  z-index: 10;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

/* Spinning Shuriken Logo */
.shuriken-logo {
  position: relative;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: transparent !important;
  animation: spin-shuriken-active 7s infinite linear;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.shuriken-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.7));
  transition: var(--transition-spring);
}

.shuriken-logo:hover .shuriken-svg {
  transform: scale(1.15);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.95));
}

@keyframes spin-shuriken-active {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.brand h1 {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.topbar-center {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.project-selector-container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.project-selector-container .label {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.project-selector-container .value {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.status-indicator-pulse {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.status-indicator-pulse.online {
  background-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-cyan);
  animation: pulse-dot 1.5s infinite;
}

.status-indicator-pulse.offline {
  background-color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.status-text {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.topbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.budget-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 0, 0.15);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.budget-depleted {
  color: #ef4444 !important;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.budget-total {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.budget-depleted .budget-total {
  color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7) !important;
}

.budget-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.budget-spent {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.budget-total {
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.budget-bar {
  width: 60px;
  height: 4px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 20px;
  margin-top: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.budget-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background-color: var(--accent-cyan);
  border-radius: 20px;
}

/* Custom Japanese SVG Icon styling */
.jp-icon {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  vertical-align: middle;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.jp-icon.text-orange {
  color: var(--accent-purple);
}

.jp-icon.text-green {
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}



/* Base Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 18px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.btn-icon {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-purple) 0%, #cc5200 120%);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.2);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.45);
}

.btn-outline {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border-color: var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.btn-outline:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-color: var(--border-hover);
}

.btn-purple {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.12);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.25);
  color: #ff9133;
}

.btn-purple:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.2);
  border-color: rgba(255, 115, 0, 0.4);
}

.btn-danger {
  background-color: #ef4444;
  color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
}

.btn-danger:hover {
  background-color: #dc2626;
  border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4);
}

.btn-sm {
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* Badges */
.badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.badge-orange {
